official_primary_definition_read.paraphrase: The article class defines a numeric figure counter and forms the figure-name/number prefix. Its caption formatter combines that prefix with the supplied caption text. A complete hand-numbered title inside the caption argument therefore duplicates the label. This static check does not substitute for compiling the supplied TeX.

limitation: Formal typesetting and float placement remain unverified until the user authorizes a TeX runtime. Current ReportLab PDF was unaffected and retains its g17 full visual lineage.
